title: Vintage Cousances (Le Creuset) Cast Iron Fondue Set – Blue
description:
Beautiful vintage fondue set by Cousances, the high-end line of Le Creuset, in a stunning blue enamel finish. Crafted from enameled cast iron, this piece offers excellent heat retention for even cooking and keeps your fondue warm at the table for longer—perfect for cozy, shared meals.
Premium Cousances / Le Creuset quality
Durable enameled cast iron construction
Elegant blue exterior with easy-to-clean enamel interior
Even heat distribution for smooth, consistent cooking
Ideal for use over low to medium heat
As with all my items, this is a vintage piece with its own charm and patina, and may show signs of age and use. Please check the photos carefully, as they are part of the description and show the exact condition.
A rare and characterful set, perfect for collectors or fondue lovers.
